text: Numeric → pitch: rescale linearly (via scales::rescale) data range range MIDI note numbers. quantize nearest note scale/key. Keep unquantized frequency note table . Categorical → pitch: level gets distinct scale degree, factor-level order. NA → rest (silence), one-time cli message saying many. time_scale given (real-time mode, NYT piece): onset = (time - min(time)) * time_scale. Also accept difftime, POSIXct, hms, converting seconds. Otherwise: onsets = rescale(time, = c(0, length)). Warn notes collide overlap heavily. Sequence: sequence group gets timeline, groups laid end end gap seconds , factor/appearance order. pitch mapping: every note gets tonic key middle range (e.g., C5). Volume: rescale velocity 40–120 (nothing goes fully silent). Long-output guard: warning 3 minutes, hard stop ~20 minutes unless force = TRUE.
